title: Redis Caching Layer
last_note: Consolidated ScanCacheService + DiscoveryEligibilityCacheService + UserServiceClientImpl's inline profile cache into one DiscoveryCacheService (session location, nearby results, active-sessions Set, eligible-users Set, trust-metadata hash, and true Cache-Aside profile/blocklist lookups that now fetch-on-miss via UserServiceClient instead of always calling upstream live). UserServiceClientImpl reduced to a pure WebClient client with no Redis dependency. gender/women_only keys deliberately left on raw RedisTemplate in ScanSessionServiceImpl/ScanQueryServiceImpl (no TTL, not a cache/membership-set concern, outside T026's key table -- same scope line T023 already drew for ScanCacheService). Added discovery.cache.session-location-ttl-seconds (default 30) to DiscoveryProperties/application.yml, replacing a hardcoded Duration.ofSeconds(30). Deleted the two superseded cache classes and updated all their callers (ScanSessionServiceImpl, ScanQueryServiceImpl, BleTokenServiceImpl, UserVerifiedEventListener, TrustScoreUpdatedEventListener). Verified with `mvnw -o compile` -- clean build, no leftover references to removed classes/methods (grep-verified).
